desc: Derive the potential formulation and geometric pairwise conflict characterization.
Establish that infeasibility is characterized by pairwise conflicts.
Identify same-direction proper crossings and opposite-direction shared-endpoint conflicts.
Reduce range feasibility queries to the suffix minimum of each person’s earliest conflicting later index.
Restrict crossing queries to equal orientations.
Sort endpoint-group lists and verify opposite-orientation endpoint conflict detection.
Validate the corrected algorithm on both public samples.
Provide the final stdin/stdout Python solution.
